description: Water Supply Main Pipelines (Other Authority) is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Corporation. Layer containing water supply main centrelines for other authorities (assets not owned by Melbourne Water). This layer is generated from data received from other Water Authorities (Barwon Water, Gippsland Water, DELWP and other). Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Corporation. Its tags are assets, centreline, melbourne, other authority, water main. It offers 6 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2025-02-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
